title: Cedfin / Tŷ Mawr — Stewart-plan parcel register and mapped outlines

georeferencing.method: affine correction from 7 control points (OpenStreetMap / OS six-inch c.1900 as reference)
georeferencing.note: The 6.8 m RMS describes the 7-control-point affine correction to OpenStreetMap / OS six-inch c.1900; the ~13 m RMS describes the separate Stewart-plan-to-tithe fit. These are fit residuals, not parcel-specific guarantees.

register_notes: The source register enumerates 59 numbered plan entries.
Numbers 1–4 are represented together by the homestead-group geometry; the small figures are not separately legible.
Number 18 has no readable figure or assigned outline in the source register.
Numbers 46–59 are not found as separate parcel numbers in the current reading; the source notes that figures resembling 50–59 may instead be old-style 30–39.
Two further mapped areas are labelled not read A and not read B.
provenance: Every register field is copied from the source CSV. Polygon coordinates are copied unchanged from the source parcels.json and matched only by the exact Stewart number / group label. Entries without source geometry remain geometry:null; no missing polygon is inferred or fabricated.
